Flooring Installation Register 20 checkpoints across 5 sections.Daily during entire flooring works phase, from substrate prep through curing Download ExcelDownload PDF **20** Checkpoints **5** Sections Daily entries; weekly and monthly reviews Site Supervisor, QC Engineer [IS 1237:2012](https://infralens.in/code/IS-1237-2015) [IS 13801:2008](https://infralens.in/code/IS-13801-1993) [IS 15622:2016](https://infralens.in/code/IS-15622-2017) Related [📐IS 1237](https://infralens.in/code/IS-1237) [✏️Tile Floor Section Thickness](https://infralens.in/thumbrules/tile-floor-section-thickness) [📘Concrete Cover Requirements](https://infralens.in/handbook/concrete-cover) [📖Min cover for RCC](https://infralens.in/knowledge/minimum-cover-rcc-is-456) [🔧rcc-design](https://infralens.in/tools/rcc-design) ### Checklist Preview Expand all ↓ | S.No. | Checkpoint | IS Requirement | Status | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | A. DAILY WORK LOG | | A1 | Date and Day

Acceptance: Area measured and recorded in square meters | Quantify daily progress | OK

Acceptance: Running total maintained; cross-checked weekly | Track total progress to date | OK
NC

NA

NC

Acceptance: Checked daily; level, compaction, cleanliness verified | Verify base preparation before laying | OK

NA
HOLD | | C2 | Tile Laying Inspection (alignment, leveling, adhesion checks)
Acceptance: Straightedge checks, joint spacing verification, visual inspection | Daily quality monitoring during laying phase | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C3 | Pull-off Test Conducted (sample count, results)
Acceptance: Minimum 1 test per 100 m², results ≥2.0 MPa; recorded with location | Verify adhesion bond strength | OK
NC
NA

Acceptance: Joint completeness, absence of voids, uniform finish verified | Monitor grouting phase quality | OK
NC
NA

Acceptance: Any NC logged with details, corrective action documented, re-checked | Document and track defects and corrections | OK
